gap: No result ChatGPT got states how long the Carpuride W903 takes from power-on to recording. The Tiny Campervan's write-up of the Lens Of James video timed 7 s to the home screen, 8 s more until the dash cam is recording (about 15 s in all) and 22 s to Android Auto.
standout_why: I could not open the cited Road & Track piece or Car and Driver's tested list: my fetch tool can't reach roadandtrack.com, caranddriver.com or web.archive.org. dashgearlab.com and techreviewsuk.com failed with certificate errors. Search results describing Road & Track's pick (the W903 as its 'best overall', on sale) showed no timings, and nothing I found shows Car and Driver or Autoweek publishing per-unit boot or connect times. The rival pages I could reach (BGR, CBS Essentials, Cybernews, Park(ing) Day) give only maker brightness ratings and prices. I could not check Road & Track or Car and Driver myself, so I rate this 2, not 3. For the same reason I can't prove the timing is missing from those two pages.
decides: It backs the W903 as the pick but adds a caveat. The dash cam is not recording for about the first 15 s after power-on, and wireless CarPlay touch input lagged about 2 s in CarPlay Life's test. I found no timed figures for the Rexing CPDuo-686 or the ESSGOO 10.26-inch, so the W903 is the only candidate where the startup gap can be quoted. Store price check: on 2026-11-14 the W903 with front and rear cameras was $249.99 at carpuride.com, not the $242.99 ChatGPT showed.
